FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Cozy Nest Bath & Bedding, we specialize in providing a wide range of high-quality bath and bedding products, including linens, towels, comforters, and decorative accessories. Our operations focus on delivering exceptional customer service and creating a welcoming shopping environment that allows customers to explore our products effectively. 

We maintain strict inventory controls, with regular audits conducted quarterly to ensure accuracy and prevent discrepancies. High-value items are secured in locked display cases and monitored with state-of-the-art CCTV surveillance to deter theft. All employees receive annual training on inventory management and theft prevention to uphold operational compliance and enhance security measures. 

Our store complies with all local fire codes, featuring functional fire suppression systems to mitigate risks associated with flammable materials. We source our inventory exclusively from reputable domestic wholesalers, ensuring quality control without the complications of direct imports. With a commitment to transparency, we maintain thorough documentation for all our supply chain transactions, creating a reliable operational framework that prioritizes customer satisfaction and safety.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 08/15/2023, a fire incident caused significant damage to our inventory, resulting in a loss of $7,500. The cause was traced to an electrical malfunction, leading to a thorough investigation and subsequent repairs. The incident has been resolved, and we have since implemented additional safety measures to prevent future occurrences. Status: Closed.
